whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Be Happy Nutrition & Fitness Center,

I noticed your wellness centre has an incredible 5.0★ rating with 130+ reviews in Kankarbagh, Patna, but your online booking and program consultation could be much faster for mobile users.

Maine aapke fitness centre ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, weight loss success stories, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://be-happy-nutrition.grexa.site/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Pankaj Raj sir / Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Be Happy Nutrition & Fitness Center) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp consultation booking, mobile-first speed, and showcasing your phenomenal weight loss results in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual transformation photos aur contact setup integrate karke aur behtar bana sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
